# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** twenty-year-old  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 ch.Autumn P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 ch.Proposal P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 ch.Proposal P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Barney Pullen is a large, overweight young man with a wide, freckle-covered face. His features are round and generally devoid of expression.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 ch.Autumn P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)_

## Personality

Barney Pullen is a quiet, emotionless young man who possesses very little capacity for chatter or laughter and suffers from an agonizing inability to hold a conversation. Described as bashful and extremely timid, particularly regarding courting, he relies on others to speak on his behalf. Despite his reticence, he is a hardworking, reliable individual who demonstrates good sense and lacks vices.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 ch.Proposal P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 ch.Proposal P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 ch.Proposal P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022)_

## History

Barney Pullen was given the upper farm under his own name by his father, leaving him free to take a bride. His sister, [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md), proposed marriage to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) on his behalf on New Year's Eve, but [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) firmly declined the offer. Following Nell's rejection, Barney subsequently married.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Proposal P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 ch.Proposal P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016), [v3 ch.Proposal P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 ch.Proposal P25](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0025), [v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000), [v3 ch.Life P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006), +2 more_

## Relationships

### [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/barney-pullen--odette-pullen.md)

[Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) is Barney's sister, and the two often travel together to social gatherings, such as escorting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde to the [Pale Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel) while Barney waits outside. [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) actively manages her bashful brother's romantic life, even going so far as to propose marriage to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) on Barney's behalf on New Year's Eve. Following Nell's firm refusal, [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) coolly accepts the outcome and correctly predicts Barney's alternative match before planning her own move West.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), +15 more_

- Sibling of — brother  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P27](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0027), [v3 ch.Proposal P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005)</sub>

### [Nettie Scobie](../character/nettie-scobie.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/barney-pullen--nettie-scobie.md)

Nettie becomes Barney's wife by the third volume. Prior to their marriage, [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) noted that Barney would likely marry Nettie as an alternative option after [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) rejected his proxy proposal. By the time [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), Barney's marriage to Nettie has taken place.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
